label: Finite controls for q44 essential-source selection
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Four explicit finite interpretations over three beings. The first three each have a participant and a distinct actual OwnBeing cause of its esse but fail selection: respectively the identity dictionary, at-most-one or selected identity witness fails while the other two selection premises hold. The fourth satisfies all selection premises, participant source supply and participation of all others; every other being is CREATURE_1 and the primary causes the effect. Facts about encoded interpretations only, not their metaphysical possibility or evidence against any premise.
